question_text: How many detections had low confidence today, say below 85%?

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE confidence < 0.85 AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.tests: below 85% -> confidence < 0.85, today -> the available day
